intent.proves: Every completed, non-deleted order has an order state.
intent.scope: completed orders excluding quotes, ledger entries and subscription base orders; complete enumeration

bindings.query: SELECT OrderId FROM EcomOrders WHERE OrderComplete = 1 AND ISNULL(OrderDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsQuote, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsLedgerEntry, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderIsRecurringOrderTemplate, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(OrderStateId, N'') = N''

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
